KILOMAX PRO-18A 18" Professional Series Speaker

KILOMAX PRO-18A 18" Professional Series Speaker

SKU:18299D-U

Dealer Only Product
Quantity

Recommended for professional audio subwoofer and woofer applications in sealed and vented enclosures. Not for horn-loading or scoops.

Applications

Subwoofer | Woofer | Pro Audio

Box Type: Sealed | Vented
